query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `campaign_sequences` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `agency_id` int NOT NULL,
  `client_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `lead_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `trigger_event` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lead_created',
  `is_active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `stop_on_appointment` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `stop_on_reply` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `created_by` int NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `campaign_sequence_steps` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `sequence_id` int NOT NULL,
  `step_order` int NOT NULL,
  `channel` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `delay_hours` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `subject` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `is_active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `campaign_enrollments` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `sequence_id` int NOT NULL,
  `lead_id` int NOT NULL,
  `agency_id` int NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `current_step` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `next_step_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `enrolled_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `completed_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `stopped_reason` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `campaign_step_logs` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `enrollment_id` int NOT NULL,
  `step_id` int NOT NULL,
  `lead_id` int NOT NULL,
  `channel` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sent',
  `external_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_message` text,
  `sent_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
